# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi
# SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later
"""Publish closed actual lifetime checks without turning diagnostics into speed evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import difflib
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
W = G / '.worktree/feat-phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013'
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-phase-cache-model-lifetime'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase_lifetime_publication_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def hashes(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: hashes(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [hashes(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
        return dict(sha256=value)
    return value


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(hashes(value), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')


def archive(path, target):
    dump(target, dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), text=path.read_text()))


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-phase-cache-lifetime-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not F.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True,
             commands=[], evidence={}, gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False)

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    env = dict(load(B / 'main-phase-cache-serial-gate-build-root-v6/record.json')['environment'])

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        print('OWNED LIFETIME PUBLICATION ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=300, cpu=1800,
                            rss_cap=2 << 30, text_cap=8 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '54385d6f975a13df5da87f489614d0b729d2aba6'
        assert run('branch', ['git', 'branch', '--show-current']) == 'feat/phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013'
        assert run('source-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all']) == 'M src/program/generate.cpp'
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        names = ['main-phase-cache-serial-gate-build-root-v6',
                 'main-phase-cache-serial-gate-lints-root-v4',
                 'main-phase-cache-model-lifetime-root-v1',
                 'main-phase-cache-model-lifetime-root-v2',
                 'main-phase-cache-model-lifetime-root-v3']
        originals = {name: B / name / 'record.json' for name in names}
        data = {name: load(path) for name, path in originals.items()}
        pins = {str(path): m.sha(path) for path in originals.values()}
        for name, d in data.items():
            assert not d['active'], name
            for c in d['commands']:
                assert c['direct_child_reaped'] and c['session_empty'] and c['session_anchored'], (name, c['label'])
                ident = m.identity(c['pid'])
                assert ident is None or ident['start_ticks'] != c['direct_identity']['start_ticks']
                if name not in names[2:4]:
                    assert m.closed(c), (name, c['label'])
        build, lint, good = (data[names[i]] for i in (0, 1, 4))
        assert build['passed'] and lint['passed'] and lint['lints_qualified'] and not lint['novel_findings']
        assert good['passed'] and good['complete'] and good['phase_engine_lifetime_qualified']
        assert not good['performance_eligible'] and not good['performance_samples']
        assert good['source_pins'] == build['source_pins'] == lint['source_pins']
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in build['source_pins'].items())
        assert all(m.sha(W / 'build' / mode / 'strata') == build[mode]['binary_sha256'] for mode in ('free', 'contrib-llvm'))
        assert not data[names[2]]['passed'] and not data[names[3]]['passed']
        assert good['normal_quit']['engine_exit'] == 0 and not good['normal_quit']['fallback_signals']
        assert good['model-hashes-before']['files'] == good['model-hashes-after']['files']
        assert all(not k['fault_entries'] and not k['dump_present'] for k in good['kernel_checks'].values())
        F.mkdir()
        derivations, deletions = [], []
        for name, d in data.items():
            public = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k != 'evidence'}
            public['output_evidence'] = {}
            for label, streams in d.get('evidence', {}).items():
                public['output_evidence'][label] = {}
                for stream, text in streams.items():
                    rows = text.splitlines()
                    kept = rows if label != 'engine-phase-lifetime' else [
                        row for row in rows if 'slot_checked' not in row and
                        (stream == 'stdout' or re.search(r'phase-cache:|FATAL|ERROR|error:|validation|prompt_stats|SYNC|pool|reset|READY|QUIT', row))]
                    item = dict(bytes=len(text.encode()), sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                                retained_lines=kept, extraction='Protocol and phase/correctness/error/lifetime summaries; original pinned receipt unchanged')
                    if label == 'engine-phase-lifetime' and stream == 'stderr':
                        slots = [row for row in rows if 'strata phase-cache: slot_checked ' in row]
                        item['checked_slots'] = [dict(zip(('layer', 'expert', 'slot', 'bytes', 'fnv1a64'), match.groups()))
                            for row in slots if (match := re.search(r'layer=(\d+) expert=(\d+) slot=(\d+) bytes=(\d+) fnv1a64=([0-9a-f]{16})', row))]
                        assert len(item['checked_slots']) == len(slots)
                    public['output_evidence'][label][stream] = item
            target = F / 'receipts' / (name + '.json')
            dump(target, public)
            derivations.append(dict(original_path=str(originals[name]), original_sha256=pins[str(originals[name])],
                                    public_path=str(target.relative_to(F)), public_sha256=m.sha(target)))
            for raw in sorted((originals[name].parent / 'commands').glob('*')):
                if raw.suffix not in ('.stdout', '.stderr') or not raw.is_file():
                    continue
                assert raw.read_text() == d['evidence'][raw.stem][raw.suffix[1:]]
                deletions.append(dict(path=str(raw), bytes=raw.stat().st_size, sha256=m.sha(raw),
                    replacement=str(target.relative_to(F)),
                    reason='Closed raw duplicate; immutable original receipt and reviewed compact diagnostic retain evidence'))
        dump(F / 'receipt-derivations.json', derivations)
        for name in ('main-phase-cache-serial-gate-build-v6.py', 'main-phase-cache-serial-gate-lints-v4.py',
                     'main-phase-cache-model-lifetime-v1.py', 'main-phase-cache-model-lifetime-v2.py',
                     'main-phase-cache-model-lifetime-v3.py', 'main-phase-cache-lifetime-publication-v1.py'):
            archive(B / name, F / 'controllers' / (name + '.json'))
        reports = ['implementation-phase-single-gpu-serial-admission-v1.txt',
                   'implementation-phase-lifetime-eos-controller-correction-v1.txt',
                   'research-actual-phase-reset-memory-delta-round374-v1.txt',
                   'research-actual-phase-refill-overhead-round375-v1.txt']
        report_pins = []
        for name in reports:
            target = F / 'research' / (name + '.json')
            archive(B / 'research-20261009' / name, target)
            report_pins.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)), sha256=m.sha(target)))
        previous = G / '.worktree/feat-fixed-history-logits-comparator-20261013/bench/results/2026-10-13-fixed-history-capture-adapter-review/report-registry-v187.json'
        assert load(previous)['research_completed'] == 913
        dump(F / 'report-registry-v188.json', dict(research_completed=917,
            prior=dict(path=str(previous), git_revision='88ebaae7ee98b908226eb880e1ba4f500dfb2c5a', sha256=m.sha(previous)),
            new_reports=report_pins, main_only_test_execution=True))
        H = G / '.worktree/feat-phase-native-head-lease-20261013'
        before, after = (W / 'src/program/generate.cpp').read_text(), (H / 'src/program/generate.cpp').read_text()
        dump(F / 'candidate-source-unqualified/head-lease-generator.json', dict(worktree=str(H),
            base_worktree=str(W), base_sha256=m.sha(W / 'src/program/generate.cpp'),
            source_sha256=m.sha(H / 'src/program/generate.cpp'),
            unified_diff=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(keepends=True), after.splitlines(keepends=True),
                fromfile='a/src/program/generate.cpp', tofile='b/src/program/generate.cpp')),
            built=False, tested=False, runtime_qualified=False,
            reason='Head-lease source inherits corrected serial pipeline0 guard; separate source-only candidate'))
        summary = dict(source_parent=good['source_revision'], source_pins=build['source_pins'],
            sourceLLVM_builds_passed=['free', 'contrib-llvm'], new_lint_findings=0,
            prior_host_asan_ubsan_and_tiny_vmm_inherited=True,
            model_engine_lifetime_qualified=True, requests=good['requests'],
            normal_quit=good['normal_quit'], kernel_checks=good['kernel_checks'],
            performance_eligible=False, performance_samples=[], adopted=False,
            quality_qualified=False, full_physical262144_qualified=False,
            original_v1_v2_failed_status_preserved=True, original_v2_cleanup='owned SIGTERM after harness rejected valid EOS',
            guard_fix='Single-GPU non-MTP serial mode requires actual pipeline_windows=0, not1',
            main_errata=['R356 1180698624 bytes is GDN shared-region candidate, not total Prefill::bytes_needed; earlier total/fit implications are withdrawn.',
                'GDN chooser temporary bytes use actual T; T1023 is25116672 bytes, not192MiB. Its function-local free precedes reset.',
                'R375 timer subtotal is nested diagnostic accounting, not measured PCIe bandwidth or accepted throughput. FNV attribution remains a hypothesis.',
                'R375 report says no Git action; agent separately disclosed initial read-only rev-parse/status. No Git mutation or tests occurred.'],
            research_registry_count=917,
            next_step='Quiet phase OFF/ON using unchanged pristine upstream bench.sh --long --runs3; assess prefill and decode independently')
        dump(F / 'summary.json', summary)
        ja = '''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Phase cache の実モデル寿命確認

Arc B570 / Ryzen 5600X、free の実モデルで fresh 1024 と 32768 入力を
同じ process に送り、追加 cache の checked map・copy・readback・比較、
二回目の解放と workspace 再作成、正常 QUIT と exit 0 を確認しました。
検査前後でモデル・provider の hash が一致し、新しい GPU fault はありません。
これはログと validation を有効にした寿命検査です。性能値には採用しません。

single GPU の serial 設定は pipeline-windows=0 でした。誤った 1 の起動条件を
直し、free と contrib-llvm のビルドおよび新規 lint 指摘 0 件を確認しました。
元の起動失敗 v1 と、正常な EOS を検査側が誤判定して停止した v2 は失敗の
まま保存しました。v3 は EOS を上限以内の正常終了と扱い、QUIT 後に判定します。

速度比較は変更していない上流 bench.sh の long、3 回測定を使います。
既定 OFF のままです。品質、全物理 262144 入力、head lease の効果は
この検査では認定していません。生成文の完全一致を品質の一般条件にはしません。

R374 により、以前の約 1.18 GB は共有領域候補だけで、workspace 全体では
ないと確認しました。従来の容量から導いた fit 推定は撤回します。R375 の
copy・readback・hash 候補は未測定です。元報告と Main の訂正は JSON に
保存しました。閉じた重複ログだけを hash 照合と削除 manifest に従って削除します。
'''
        en = '''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Actual phase cache model lifetime check

On Arc B570 / Ryzen 5600X in free mode, fresh 1024 and 32768 inputs in one
process passed checked mapping, copy, readback and comparison, second-request
detach and workspace recreation, normal QUIT and exit0. Model/provider hashes
matched before and after, with no new GPU fault. Logging and validation were
enabled; these are lifetime diagnostics and supply no performance samples.

Single-GPU serial mode uses pipeline-windows=0. Correcting the erroneous1 gate
passed free and contrib-llvm builds with zero new lint findings. Original v1
startup failure and v2 harness failure retain failed outcomes. v2 incorrectly
rejected a valid early EOS and sent owned SIGTERM; v3 accepts EOS within the
output cap and checks semantics after normal QUIT.

Performance comparisons use unchanged upstream bench.sh long with3 runs.
Default remains OFF. Quality, full physical262144 input and head-lease effects
are not qualified. Exact prose identity is not a universal quality criterion.

R374 shows that the earlier1.18 GB was only a shared-region candidate, not the
whole workspace. Prior fit implications based on that total are withdrawn.
R375 copy/readback/hash proposals are unmeasured. JSON retains original reports
and Main's errata. Only closed duplicate logs retire after hash verification,
under the deletion manifest.
'''
        (F / 'REPORT.ja.md').write_text(ja)
        (F / 'REPORT.md').write_text(en)
        retention = dict(deletions=deletions, deleted=False, owner='Main',
            active_runs_touched=False, original_pinned_receipts_retained=True,
            original_failed_status_retained=True, free_space_claim=False,
            byte_budget=4 << 20, consumer='Phase OFF/ON official benchmark and future cache/source qualification',
            next_review='After official phase comparison or superseding lifecycle evidence')
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', retention)
        files = [str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
        assert 'skipped (' not in run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files])
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in build['source_pins'].items())
        assert all(m.sha(path) == sha for path, sha in pins.items())
        assert all(m.sha(row['path']) == row['sha256'] for row in deletions)
        for row in deletions:
            Path(row['path']).unlink()
        retention.update(deleted=True, removed_file_count=len(deletions), removed_logical_bytes=sum(row['bytes'] for row in deletions))
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', retention)
        run('stage', ['git', 'add', '--', 'src/program/generate.cpp', str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'fix(xe): admit serial phase cache and qualify actual model lifetime'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'feat/phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, research_registry_count=917,
                 removed_files=len(deletions), removed_logical_bytes=retention['removed_logical_bytes'])
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({key: r.get(key) for key in ('passed', 'error', 'commit', 'research_registry_count', 'removed_files')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
